lines.en: label springtime10:
{i}Hours later — when the well has run dry...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}数小时之后——当井水已然干涸……{/i}

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong1
: Thanks for the ride, Nee-san. The limo might have been overkill, though. I would have been happy with a 99 Chevy Prizm.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你载我，Nee-san。不过叫辆加长轿车可能太夸张了。我坐一辆 99 年的 Chevrolet Prizm 就很开心了。

lines.en: : What a specific car to have used as an example there. But also, you’re welcome. Even though you should probably be thanking our vegetable of a childhood friend instead of me.
lines.zh: : 你举的例子可真具体。不过不客气。虽然你大概该感谢我们那位植物人儿时好友，而不是我。

lines.en: : If it wasn’t for him, I’d be either up on stage or...up on top of his penis right now.
lines.zh: : 要不是为了他，我现在要么在舞台上，要么……正骑在他的鸡巴上。

lines.en: : Is...that really something you should be openly admitting to your little sister?
lines.zh: : 这……真的是你该当着妹妹的面公开承认的事吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Who {i}else{/i} am I going to brag to? I don’t have any friends. The closest thing I have is that Kaori girl and that’s really just because of all the wieners.
lines.zh: : 是。我不跟妹妹炫耀还能跟谁炫耀？我一个朋友都没有。最像朋友的就是那个 Kaori 姑娘，而那也纯粹是因为那些香肠。

lines.en: : Also, we don’t know for sure that Akira is a vegetable. Like, we haven’t even seen him since he got “sick.” Which is obviously just a front perpetuated by the world’s clingiest niece.
lines.zh: : 再说，我们也不确定 Akira 就是个植物人。毕竟他「生病」之后我们都没见过他。那显然只是世上最黏人的侄女编出来的幌子。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong2
: Yeah. That’s really starting to piss me off. Fool me once by keeping my boyfriend locked in his room for a whole month, shame on me. Fool me twice by keeping my boyfriend locked-
lines.zh: : 是啊。这事真的开始让我火大了。骗我一次，把我男朋友关在房间里整整一个月，算我蠢。再骗我第二次，还把我男朋友关——

lines.en: : Yeah, I...I get it, Nee-san. He’s been in there for a while. But...at least we know where he is this time, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……我懂，Nee-san。他已经在里面待了一阵子了。可是……至少这次我们知道他在哪儿，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...but something’s really fishy about this whole thing. It’s textbook Akira to disappear when things get too hard, but why does {i}Ami{/i} seem so...fine?
lines.zh: : 是啊……可整件事真的透着古怪。一遇到困难就消失是 Akira 的老套路，可为什么 {i}Ami{/i} 看起来那么……若无其事？

lines.en: : Like, what could have gotten to {i}him{/i} so badly but not her?
lines.zh: : 就是说，到底有什么事把{i}他{/i}打击得那么惨，却没影响到她？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong3
: I say we kill her and start taking care of him ourselves. I’m rich. Kind of. I could get away with it.
lines.zh: : 我说我们干脆杀了她，自己接手照顾他。我有钱。算是吧。我能脱身的。

lines.en: : That...is definitely one way to handle this. Sure. But I’m kind of reluctant to do anything that drastic right now since it could always just make Akira even {i}worse.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那……确实是处理这事的一种方式。当然。不过我不太愿意现在就做得这么极端，因为那随时可能让 Akira 的情况变得{i}更糟{/i}。

lines.en: : So...it’s not the murder you have a problem with. It’s the fact that engaging in murder could make Akira like you less.
lines.zh: : 所以……你有意见的不是谋杀本身。而是参与谋杀可能会让 Akira 没那么喜欢你。

lines.en: : I said what I said.
lines.zh: : 我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Well, you’re definitely a Nakayama alright.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你确实是个不折不扣的 Nakayama。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong4
: Was the bright pink hair not a big enough giveaway?
lines.zh: : 我那头亮粉色的头发还不够说明问题吗？

lines.en: : Do you think he’ll actually get to open our presents? Or do you think Ami threw them right into the trash the moment we left?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他真能拆到我们的礼物吗？还是你觉得我们一走，Ami 就把它们直接扔进垃圾桶了？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong5

: It’s hard to ever know with her. Like, some days, she seems like such an amazing, caring girl. Then others, it’s like she’s got so many screws loose that she’s the physical manifestation of a Home Depot dustbin.
lines.zh: : 她这个人你永远猜不透。比如，有些日子她看起来就像个又贴心又了不起的女孩。可另一些日子，她就像是螺丝松了一大堆，活脱脱成了 Home Depot 垃圾桶的实体化身。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. Why do you think I’m so nice to her all the time?
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。你觉得我为什么一直对她那么好？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong6
: Because...you want Akira to like you as much as possible and it would be hard to win him over while trashing the only surviving member of his family?
lines.zh: : 因为……你想让 Akira 尽可能喜欢你，而一边讨好他、一边痛骂他唯一幸存的家人，是很难赢到他的？

lines.en: : That’s definitely a part of it, sure.
lines.zh: : 那肯定是其中一部分，没错。

lines.en: : And there’s also a part of {i}me{/i} who remembers when she was a little kid. And yes, some kids grow up to be brats and just {i}remembering{/i} them shouldn’t give them a pass.
lines.zh: : 而我心里还有一部分记得她小时候的样子。是啊，有些孩子长大就成了熊孩子，光凭{i}记得{/i}他们小时候并不该给他们免死金牌。

lines.en: : But {i}not{/i} everyone’s parents die in a car crash.
lines.zh: : 可不是所有人的父母都死在车祸里。

lines.en: : And {i}not{/i} everyone has to grow up in a household without a real guardian, taking care of a broken man who managed to break even {i}more{/i} after that same accident.
lines.zh: : 也不是所有人都得在一个没有真正监护人的家庭里长大，照顾一个本就破碎、又在那场事故后碎得更彻底的男人。

lines.en: : Ami’s been through a lot. Now, does that excuse her from being a control freak who won’t accept outside help from two people who have known him just as long as she has? Of course not.
lines.zh: : Ami 经历了很多。当然，这不能成为她是个控制狂、不肯接受两个认识他跟她一样久的人的帮助的借口。当然不能。

lines.en: : But we need to remember that she’s just as fragile as him. And that she {i}is{/i} the physical manifestation of a Home Depot dustbin.
lines.zh: : 但我们得记住，她和他一样脆弱。而且她就是 Home Depot 垃圾桶的实体化身。

lines.en: : That speech almost made me forget that you suggested we kill her a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你这一席话差点让我忘了你几分钟前还建议我们杀了她。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong7
: I, too, am an enigma. And one that has accepted that sometimes, shit is just going to get really weird and there is basically nothing I can do about it.
lines.zh: : 我自己也是个谜。而且我已经接受了——有时候事情就是会变得非常诡异，而我基本上无能为力。

lines.en: : How much longer are you willing to wait, though? Because at this rate, I’m starting to worry he might {i}never{/i} leave that house again without some...interference.
lines.zh: : 不过你还愿意等多久？因为照这个速度，我开始担心他可能永远不会再走出那栋房子了，除非有某种……介入。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong8
: You know what would {i}really{/i} suck? If he wasn’t even there and Ami was just stalling us while he {i}flees{/i} again.
lines.zh: : 你知道什么才真的糟吗？如果他根本不在那儿，而 Ami 只是在拖延我们，等他再次逃跑。

lines.en: : Nee-san. I will fucking {i}kill{/i} you if you joke about that again.
lines.zh: : Nee-san。你要是再拿这个开玩笑，我他妈就杀了你。

lines.en: : Oh, so {i}now{/i} murder is okay when the target is your own flesh and blood? Real cool, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 哦，那么{i}现在{/i}谋杀就没问题了，只要目标是你的亲骨肉？真有你的，Noriko。

lines.en: : How could you even say that with a straight face?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能面不改色地说出这种话？

lines.en: : Easy. Now that he knows how great it is to have sex with me, he’d obviously never run away again. And if he did, he’d come right back the second he gets a boner.
lines.zh: : 简单啊。既然他已经知道跟我上床有多棒，他显然再也不会跑了。就算跑了，只要一勃起他就会马上回来。

lines.en: : Don’t tell Mom I said that.
lines.zh: : 别跟妈说我说了这个。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong9
: I am going to go inside and deliver this present now. Please never speak to me again.
lines.zh: : 我现在要进去送这份礼物了。请你以后永远别再跟我说话。

lines.en: : Wait...Noriko.
lines.zh: : 等等……Noriko。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong10
: You dare stop me when-
lines.zh: : 你竟敢拦我——

lines.en: : Who was that girl yesterday?
lines.zh: : 昨天那个女孩是谁？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong11
: Girl? What girl?
lines.zh: : 女孩？什么女孩？

lines.en: : The one who stormed out and slammed the door when we walked into Akira’s house.
lines.zh: : 我们走进 Akira 家时，那个冲出去、把门摔上的。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong12
: Oh. Maya. Yeah, we’re kind of rivals...or something.
lines.zh: : 哦。Maya。是啊，我们算是对手……之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t really know. Sensei used to tutor her as well and she kind of just hates me now because I still like him.
lines.zh: : 我也说不清。Sensei 以前也辅导过她，而她现在就是恨我，因为我依然喜欢他。

lines.en: : So...she likes Akira as well?
lines.zh: : 所以……她也喜欢 Akira？

lines.en: : Who {i}doesn’t{/i} in this city? I feel like he’s even more popular than {i}you{/i} are and you’re on billboards.
lines.zh: : 这座城市里有谁不喜欢他？我觉得他甚至比你还受欢迎，而你可是上广告牌的人。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong13
: Why do you ask, though? She was gone so quickly that I didn’t even realize you noticed her.
lines.zh: : 不过你为什么问这个？她走得那么快，我都没注意到你看见她了。

lines.en: : I don’t really know...
lines.zh: : 我也说不上来……

lines.en: : Something just felt kind of...{i}off{/i} about her. Like I recognize her from somewhere or...
lines.zh: : 只是觉得她有点……不对劲。就像我在哪儿见过她，或者……

lines.en: : I can’t really remember...
lines.zh: : 我真的想不起来了……

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong14
: Well, you’re definitely right about something being {i}off.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，你说有不对劲的地方，绝对没错。

lines.en: : I’ve been thinking the same thing lately. Just...in a way that probably wouldn’t make any sense to someone who just saw her for the first time.
lines.zh: : 我最近也在想同样的事。只是……这种方式，对一个只见了她一面的人来说大概说不通。

lines.en: : Uhh...what? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？那是什么意思？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong15
: She’s been, like...{i}different{/i} lately.
lines.zh: : 她最近……变得不一样了。

lines.en: scene amibreak4
scene redstring2
scene amessageee7
scene mercy3
scene redstring2
scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong16
And so she told her-
lines.zh: 于是她告诉了她——

lines.en: Of the drastic difference between what once was and what now is — laced by a tinge of desperation and the desire not to understand, but to know.
lines.zh: 曾经的模样与如今的模样之间那剧烈的差别——夹杂着一抹绝望，以及一种不是想「理解」、而是想「知道」的渴望。

lines.en: She told her of the girl with eyes a step removed from aquamarine — who loved melons and hated {i}her.{/i} How she nearly lunged for her throat the moment they were reacquainted.
lines.zh: 她告诉她，那个眼睛离蓝绿色只有一步之遥的女孩——她爱蜜瓜，恨{i}她{/i}。她们重逢的那一刻，她差点扑上去掐住她的喉咙。

lines.en: How she did it again just last month.
lines.zh: 以及她上个月又干了一次。

lines.en: And how no one batted an eye.
lines.zh: 而没有任何人眨一下眼。

lines.en: No one thought it was {i}strange{/i} or {i}uncharacteristic.{/i} And these were all people that the girl in question appeared to ally herself with.
lines.zh: 谁都不觉得那奇怪、也不觉得那不像她的作风。而这些都是那个女孩似乎与之结盟的人。

lines.en: Noriko Nakayama believed, in her heart of purest hearts, that she was fit to be an ally — yet the stars and their subjects had ideas far detached from such a thing.
lines.zh: Noriko Nakayama 在她最纯净的内心里相信，自己配得上做一名盟友——可星辰与它们的臣民，却有着与此截然不同的安排。

lines.en: Why was it that {i}she,{/i} the one with olive branches for arms and exit signs for eyes, had to be the one tossed into the bonfire while her peers warmed their hands in blissful ignorance?
lines.zh: 为什么偏偏是{i}她{/i}——那个以橄榄枝为手臂、以出口标志为眼睛的人——被扔进篝火，而她的同伴们却在幸福的无知中烤着手？

lines.en: Each step deeper into the throat of a hotel where she would one day be betrayed caused a shooting pain to radiate from her left leg up to her neck and then right back down to its origin point.
lines.zh: 每往那家她终有一天会被背叛的酒店的咽喉深处走一步，就有一阵刺痛从她的左腿放射到脖子，再一路回到原点。

lines.en: She avoided the cracks in the tiled floor, but would deny to herself that it was superstition compelling her to act in such a manner.
lines.zh: 她避开地砖上的裂缝，却不肯对自己承认，驱使自己这么做的是迷信。

lines.en: Upon accidentally breaking her own traditions and worrying for a brief moment that she’d burst into flames due to failure, a thought crosses her eyelids before injecting itself into her nucleus.
lines.zh: 就在她无意中打破了自己的规矩、短暂地担心自己会因失败而自燃时，一个念头掠过她的眼睑，然后注入了她的细胞核。

lines.en: Am I going insane?
lines.zh: 我是不是疯了？

lines.en: Am I the only one who sees what’s happened?
lines.zh: 只有我一个人看见了发生的事吗？

lines.en: When did the sun fall asleep? And when did twenty become nineteen?
lines.zh: 太阳是什么时候睡着的？而二十又是什么时候变成了十九？

lines.en: The tiled floor’s response was not in words, but in soft clops as tradition reformed and reminded her that she would not burn to death today.
lines.zh: 地砖的回应不是言语，而是轻柔的脚步声——传统重新成形，提醒她今天不会烧死。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong18
She enters a room that lacks color.
lines.zh: 她走进一个没有颜色的房间。

lines.en: She looks around.
lines.zh: 她环顾四周。

lines.en: No more gaps in the tiles. No numbers on doors or discarded room service trays spilling their guts out into the stomach of the hallway.
lines.zh: 地砖上再没有缝隙。门上没有号码，也没有丢弃的客房餐盘把内脏泼洒在走廊的胃里。

lines.en: Which of these greyscale creatures would tie a rope around her neck and pull her in before her incessant drive to destroy herself would cause her to act out and just {i}ask{/i} what she wanted to ask?
lines.zh: 在这些灰阶生物之中，哪一个会先在她脖子上套一根绳子、把她拉进去，抢在她那不停自毁的冲动发作、直接开口问出她想问的问题之前？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong17
The color returns.
lines.zh: 颜色回来了。

lines.en: More steps are removed from aquamarine.
lines.zh: 又多了几步，远离那片蓝绿色。

lines.en: : Hell nah. We really just gonna ignore how Rin’s plagiarizing my whole ass fit? Cause I don’t remember signing off on this. And I sign a lot of shit, yo.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。我们真要当作没看见 Rin 抄了我他妈的整身穿搭？因为我不记得我批准过。而我可是签了很多东西的，喂。

lines.en: : I’m not plagiarizing anything! My outfit’s like...way different! Just...look! The belt...you know...I changed  how it’s positioned! And mine has...more holes in it!
lines.zh: : 我才没有抄任何东西！我这身搭配可……差别大了！就……你看！腰带……你知道……我改了它的位置！而且我这件……洞更多！

lines.en: : They {i}do{/i} say that imitation is the best form of flattery...
lines.zh: : 人家都说，模仿是最高的恭维……

lines.en: : The fuck are {i}“they?”{/i} Cause they ain’t been talkin’ to me! And if they ain’t talkin’ to me, chances are they’ve been helping Rin raid my damn closet.
lines.zh: : {i}人家{/i}是他妈的谁？因为他们可没跟我说话！而如果他们没跟我说过话，他们多半一直在帮 Rin 洗劫我的衣柜。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong19
: Ah! Noriko!
lines.zh: : 啊！Noriko！

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong20
: Hey, Molly. Hey, Tsuneyo. Merry Christmas.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Molly。嘿，Tsuneyo。圣诞快乐。

lines.en: The magnets inside of them begin to pulsate and bubble up.
lines.zh: 她们体内的磁铁开始搏动、冒泡。

lines.en: : And a merry Christmas to you as well! But that’s enough celebrating. It’s time to get down to {i}business.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也祝你圣诞快乐！不过庆祝到此为止。是时候谈正事了。

lines.en: : And you better hurry up because markets close at 4:00 PM EST and trading can become particularly volatile after-hours.
lines.zh: : 而且你最好快点，因为市场在美东时间下午 4 点收盘，盘后交易会变得格外波动。

lines.en: : Also, Christmas to you as well.
lines.zh: : 另外，也祝你圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : Tell me, psion — how does thee feel about elves and the like?
lines.zh: : 告诉我，灵能者——你觉得精灵之类的怎么样？

lines.en: : Thee feels. But thee feelsest the feels that thou feelest not.
lines.zh: : 汝有所感。只是汝所感者，乃汝所未感之感。

lines.en: : That-
scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong21
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Word.
lines.zh: : 说得好。

lines.en: : I think elves and the like are really cool. I’m just not really sure if I like them as much as you and the rest of the D&D squad if you were about to invite me to play with you guys.
lines.zh: : 我觉得精灵之类的很酷。只是我不确定自己有没有你和 D&D 小队其他人那么喜欢它们——如果你正要邀请我一起玩的话。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong22
: Huh? How did you know? Did the Kendo Princess tell you?
lines.zh: : 哈？你怎么知道的？是剑道公主告诉你的吗？

lines.en: : No. I overheard you when you drew my name for Secret Santa and then loudly proclaimed that you knew a way to give me a present without having to spend any money.
lines.zh: : 不是。你抽到我的秘密圣诞老人时我听到了，然后你大声宣称你知道有什么办法可以一分钱不花就送我礼物。

lines.en: : Then, my masterful deduction skills led me to the conclusion that you were going to do this and that I was going to tell you that it’s cool if you just don’t give me a present. I know your game is full already.
lines.zh: : 然后，凭借我高超的推理能力，我得出了结论：你打算这么做，而我要跟你说，你不送我礼物也没关系。我知道你的游戏已经满员了。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m already in the process of writing a Pathfinder campaign with my sister and I’d prefer to focus on that over joining another campaign.
lines.zh: : 再说，我已经在和我姐姐一起写一个 Pathfinder 战役了，我更想专注在那上面，而不是再加入另一个战役。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong23
: Wha- since when are you cool?! I didn’t know about that!
lines.zh: : 什——你什么时候变得这么酷了？！我都不知道！

lines.en: : It’s not really anything to write home about. We’ve been working on it for years and are still nowhere close to done, so it’ll probably never see the light of day.
lines.zh: : 这事真没什么好张扬的。我们写了好几年，到现在还远远没完成，大概永远不会见天日。

lines.en: : Have you considered making the paths easier to locate?
lines.zh: : 你有没有考虑过把路径做得更容易找到一点？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong24
: No, I’ll have to bring that up at our next sister meeting.
lines.zh: : 没有，这个我得留到下次姐妹会议上提。

lines.en: : Please let that amazing business tip be my gift to you this holiday season in lieu of the Emerald Guardian’s forgotten one.
lines.zh: : 就让这条绝妙的商业建议作为我这个节日送你的礼物，代替翡翠守护者那份被遗忘的礼物吧。

lines.en: : I...didn’t forget! I’ve just been pooling all of my money for my annual tradition of...buying myself a ton of games for Christmas and then barely talking to anyone for the next month.
lines.zh: : 我……没忘！我只是把钱全攒起来，用于我每年的传统——圣诞节给自己买一大堆游戏，然后在接下来的一个月里基本不跟任何人说话。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong25
: That is what I’d like to call a “Molly Jolly Christmas.” Bam. Zoom. Joke complete.
lines.zh: : 这就是我想称之为「Molly 欢乐圣诞」的东西。砰。唰。笑话讲完。

lines.en: : Please ignore her. She’s trying to return to the world of stand-up comedy and is having trouble coming up with a catchphrase.
lines.zh: : 请无视她。她正试图重返单口喜剧界，却想不出一句招牌台词。

lines.en: : Molly, it’s cool. I already said I don’t need a present or anything like that. Just...treat me at Koi Cafe the next time I come in or something.
lines.zh: : Molly，没关系的。我说过了，我不需要礼物之类的。就……下次我去 Koi Cafe 的时候请我就行。

lines.en: : If you insist...but do know that I am monitored very closely at work as I have been labeled a “liability” in the past.
lines.zh: : 如果你坚持的话……不过你要知道，我在工作时被盯得很紧，因为我以前被贴过「隐患」的标签。

lines.en: : Liability? More like {i}cry-{/i}ability, you little bitch. Bam. Zoom. Joke complete.
lines.zh: : 隐患？不如说是「爱{i}哭{/i}鬼」，你这个小贱人。砰。唰。笑话讲完。

lines.en: : As you can see, time away from the stand has made the Kendo Princess very rusty.
lines.zh: : 如你所见，离开表演台太久，剑道公主已经生疏了。

lines.en: : Ah! If it isn’t the girl who ditched me to hang out with her sister.
lines.zh: : 啊！这不是那个为了跟她姐姐混而甩了我的姑娘吗。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong26
: That loses a lot of impact when you say it while literally walking into the room with {i}your{/i} sister. At least I had the decency to leave mine in the car.
lines.zh: : 你一边说这话、一边正和你自己的姐姐走进房间，那可就没什么杀伤力了。至少我还算有分寸，把我姐姐留在车里了。

lines.en: : Hi Noriko! Merry Christmas! Kirin isn’t actually mad that you didn’t come shopping with us. We had a lot of fun.
lines.zh: : 你好，Noriko！圣诞快乐！Kirin 其实没有因为你没跟我们来逛街而生气。我们玩得很开心。

lines.en: : Yeah. It {i}was{/i} just going to be us two, but we wound up bumping into Touka and Yasu as well and they tagged along with us for most of the trip.
lines.zh: : 是啊。本来只有我们两个的，结果我们碰上了 Touka 和 Yasu，她们大半程都跟着我们一起逛。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Touka had something come up and she won’t be able to make it to the party tonight.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，Touka 临时有事，今晚的派对来不了了。

lines.en: : That sucks. What about Yasu, though? Where’s she?
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。那 Yasu 呢？她在哪儿？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong27
: That’s a good question. Weren’t you watching her?
lines.zh: : 问得好。不是你在看着她吗？

lines.en: : Me? I thought you said {i}you{/i} were going to watch her. She holds eye contact for too long and it makes me nervous.
lines.zh: : 我？我以为是{i}你{/i}说你会看着她的。她盯着人看的时间太长，让我紧张。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong28
: She’s around. But enough about that — what’d you get me for Christmas this year?
lines.zh: : 她就在附近。不过别聊这个了——你今年给我买了什么圣诞礼物？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong29
: I thought we weren’t exchanging gifts this year? I didn’t get you anything. And if you got {i}me{/i} something after telling me to not get you anything, I’m going to be very mad at you.
lines.zh: : 我们不是说好今年不交换礼物吗？我什么都没给你买。而如果你在让{i}我{/i}别买之后还给我买了什么，我会非常生你的气。

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong30
: Aww, Noriko. Just knowing I was able to piss you off is better than any present you could possibly-
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Noriko。光是知道我能把你惹毛，就比你可能送我的任何礼物都——

lines.en: : Kirin...look...
lines.zh: : Kirin……你看……

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong31
: Huh? Look at what?
lines.zh: : 哈？看什么？

lines.en: scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong32
scene norikoknowssomethingiswrong33
: Mistletoe...
lines.zh: : 槲寄生……

lines.en: : Ah! Look, everybody! Somebody finally fell for the trap! And by “somebody” I mean Kirin and Noriko!
lines.zh: : 啊！大家快看！终于有人中了圈套！而这个「有人」指的就是 Kirin 和 Noriko！

lines.en: : Well...it looks like we’ll just have to-
lines.zh: : 嗯……看来我们只好——

lines.en: : Oh no! I am suddenly not under the mistletoe anymore!
lines.zh: : 哦不！我突然就不在槲寄生底下了！

lines.en: : Wait! Noriko! I came up with a good idea for my Christmas present!
lines.zh: : 等等！Noriko！我想到一个关于我圣诞礼物的好主意！
